The '''Model-1 "Nova Viper" blaster pistol''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] produced by [[Raider Arms/Legends|Raider Arms]]. It was perfectly balanced, innovative, and crafted with precision down to a fraction of a micrometer. Raider Arms customized each Nova Viper sold, from the grip to the finish. Consequently, Nova Viper [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] were highly sought after and cost nearly as much as a new [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]]. This blaster’s exceptional precision came with a hidden cost, requiring meticulous maintenance and extraordinary skill to repair. Nonetheless, a fringer who acquired a Nova Viper would almost always consider themselves fortunate and regarded it as one of their most prized possessions.<ref name="Fly" />
